payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate x from 0 to n, compute t = n - x*a, if t nonnegative and divisible by b, output x and y = t/b.
payload.rationale: Simple loop over one variable is complete search. The condition t>=0 and t%b==0 prunes infeasible x, akin to branch-and-bound pruning but no branching. Chosen subtype has highest candidate score and rule suggestion.
